scrollback-inrun.reason: herdr-core's attach history paint hard-breaks soft-wrapped lines with CRLF at the paint width. A reload at a narrow width bakes those breaks into the xterm; a later reload at a wider width repaints them joined, so the screen changes with no resize (reload 1), and the line count shifts under ConPTY's cursor, so the next typed command overwrites R2-END (reload 2 then can't find it). Re-checked 2026-11-16 (CON-51): fails the same on hc 0.1.16 (run 43948758841) and on the latest hc 0.1.21 (run 43953477247, experiment only; hc stays pinned). Lift when hc keeps soft wraps in the history paint; upstream request in docs/runs/2026-11-02-three-process-build/report.md.
